seams.new:
node_modules/
# Test fixtures that must mimic an installed package tree.
!apps/cli/tests/fixtures/node_modules/
!apps/cli/tests/fixtures/node_modules/**
lib/

nodeLinker: hoisted
autoInstallPeers: false
# pnpm 11 blocks git-resolved subdependencies by default (blockExoticSubdeps):
# the Fabric trio arrives through git specs, so the profile allows them.
blockExoticSubdeps: false
# Git-hosted plugins (the trio, ex-setting) build themselves on install via
# their prepare script; pnpm 11 allowBuilds only accepts exact git+url#commit
# keys (the commit changes on every push), so the git installs are allowed
# wholesale — matching the host workspace.
dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds: true
`

seams.old:
# (git hooks) genuinely need theirs.
allowBuilds:
  esbuild: true
seams.new:
# (git hooks) genuinely need theirs.
# The Fabric trio resolves from git subdirectory specs and builds itself
# through its prepare scripts; pnpm 11 allowBuilds only accepts exact
# git+url#commit keys (the commit changes on every push), so the git
# installs are allowed wholesale.
dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds: true

allowBuilds:
  esbuild: true

seams.old:
- insert:
    - id: agent-presets
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets'
      config:
        default: standard
seams.new:
- insert:
    - id: agent-presets
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets'
      config:
        default: standard

# The Fabric extension rows are explicit opt-in (disabled by default): the
# pure `cordis-fabric` package is a library with no plugin `apply`, so an
# enabled row fails every boot. The launcher bootstrap reads the rows from
# the composed profile; a profile opts in by enabling them.
- insert:
    - id: cordis-fabric
      name: 'cordis-fabric'
      disabled: true
    - id: cordis-fabric-dsh
      name: 'cordis-fabric-dsh'
      disabled: true
